wall_hours_total_at_30_concurrent.note: Assumes 30 jobs run concurrently throughout. Each job uses 4 CPUs. identify + cctyper can overlap because they use different envs; the longer tool dominates wall time.

disk_bytes_at_full_db.note: Peak temporary during run depends on concurrent-jobs setting; work_patched sampled at steady state (post-cleanup) at 141533175 B for 1000-genome batch — not representative of in-flight peak.

sources_of_discrepancy_vs_prior_report: Prior report wrote '476 s × 4 cores = 0.53 cpu-h' — incorrect units; 476 cpu-sec = 0.132 cpu-h.
Prior report used medians for extrapolation, which underestimates because of a long tail (identify max was 1209 s vs median 96 s).
Means give a slightly larger total; both are reported here.
